headlines.text: That Friday in 2023, a new chapter began as Young Bucks & Page vs. The Embassy fought for the brand-new ROH World Six Man Tag Titles, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.16 ? a strong outing. Reuniting as "The Hung Bucks," Page and the Young Bucks overcame Swerve Strickland's ringside distractions to win the ROH World Six-Man Tag Team Titles from Mogul Embassy.

On a Wednesday in 2021, back when AEW welcomed Bryan Danielson for the first time against Kenny Omega, appearing on Dynamite, rated 9.52 ? an instant classic. A dream match to open AEW's first-ever Grand Slam ? Danielson's in-ring debut against the reigning World Champion, in front of a sold-out Arthur Ashe Stadium crowd, in what critics called one of the very best matches of his entire career.

Flash back to 2024, when Dustin Rhodes chalked up their 50th recorded AEW match ? a solid half-century of matches, facing Dustin Rhodes vs. Sammy Guevara vs. Matt Taven vs. Mike Bennett in a Bunkhouse Tag match, getting things started right out of the gate on Collision, rated 7.73 ? a well-worked match in a back-and-forth tag team affair.

secondaries.text: It was 2023 when Acclaimed & B.Gunn vs. Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) & Uno went to battle over the AEW World Trios Titles, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.67. Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) & Uno was challenging for gold for the very first time. This stood as the 20th match in AEW World Trios Titles history ? a notable milestone for the title.
It was 2024 when Cash Wheeler chalked up their 100th recorded AEW match, where FTR featured in a 10 Man Tag, topping the bill that night on Collision, rated 6.27.
Looking back to 2023, when Cage & Luchasaurus made their AEW debut as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.20.
